note: Forecast ledger, run only. Dated, falsifiable calls with a probability and a resolution date. The run adds one to three a week, never edits a call after it is made, resolves each on its date (yes, no, or void when the question stopped being meaningful) with the fact and source, and the page keeps a Brier score. Seed entries dated 7 Nov 2026 were made at the 7.0 build.

items.q: A trilateral Russia–Ukraine–US round is held in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov with both delegations present
items.why: Putin named the date on 6 Nov and Ukraine named its delegation head.

items.q: The De Wever government is still in office on 30 Nov
items.why: The King has held the resignation in suspense and is consulting party leaders.
